mainImage.alt: Palestinian woman standing outside a damaged tent near rubble of destroyed residential buildings in Gaza
mainImage.caption: A Palestinian woman amid the rubble of residential buildings destroyed by Israeli bombardment in Gaza, January 2026.

body.alt: Wide aerial view of total destruction across a neighborhood in northern Gaza, nothing standing but rubble and broken concrete
body.caption: A view of destroyed buildings in the northern Gaza Strip. Israel has reduced most of northern Gaza to uninhabitable wasteland as a prelude to settlement construction.

body.alt: Two young Palestinian girls walking through a street of destroyed buildings, rubble piled high on both sides
body.caption: Palestinian girls walk past the rubble of residential buildings destroyed by Israeli bombardment in Gaza. Over 73,000 Palestinians have been killed since October 2023.

body.alt: Israeli bulldozers and construction equipment working on barren land preparing the site for a new settlement
body.caption: Israeli bulldozers prepare land for the construction of a new settlement near the West Bank city of Jenin. Smotrich allocated $400 million for settlement expansion across the occupied West Bank.
